mechanics_summary: 100-Ki Strike Super learned through Hercule's training. The move is chargeable and short-range: the base kick is quick but the fully charged version takes several seconds to prepare and can reach a documented 25% source-reported damage. Full charge produces a multi-hit rush ending with another Dynamite Kick in the technique's broader description. Exact charge-frame timing and patch-independent damage remain unresolved.
evidence_limits: Exact startup/charge/timing/tracking and patch-independent damage values remain unresolved where not directly established.
